before.alt: Three states in a row. Start state (arrow in) --a--> middle accepting (double circle) state --ε--> third state; the third state has an ε-edge back to the start state.

after.alt: NFA with three states in a row, no self-loops. An incoming start arrow points to the first (non-accepting) state; it goes on a to the middle state, which is accepting (double circle); the middle state goes on ε to the third (non-accepting) state; a curved ε-edge below leads from the third state back to the first state.
